title: Simultaneous finite compact-open cover descent with prescribed inclusions
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder, S_i spectral spaces, and f_ij:S_j→S_i spectral transition maps with identity and composition laws. Let X be their topological inverse limit with projections p_i [def-weil-spectral-space]. Fix i and compact open U⊆S_i. Let n≥0, V_a⊆S_i and W_a⊆X be compact opens indexed by Fin n, with p_i⁻¹U=⋃_a W_a and W_a⊆p_i⁻¹V_a. Then there are j≥i and compact opens D_a⊆S_j such that f_ij⁻¹U=⋃_a D_a, p_j⁻¹D_a=W_a, and D_a⊆f_ij⁻¹V_a for every a.

source.place: Tag 0A32, lemma-compute-pullback-to-limit, simultaneous cover descent in the surjectivity paragraph; Topology, Tag 0A30(1)-(3).

proof.text: Descend each W_a to a compact open in a stage using part (1) of compact-open descent. A common upper bound of these finitely many stages and i gives representatives E_a at one stage k. Their pullbacks are still W_a and they remain compact open.
Descend the finite covering equality by part (3), giving a later stage q where these opens cover f_iq⁻¹U.

Apply part (2) separately to each inclusion W_a⊆p_i⁻¹V_a. Pull the opens at q to a common upper bound of the finitely many resulting stages. The covering equality, pullback identities and inclusions persist under inverse image. Empty families are included by inserting q into the finite set used for the upper bound.

from.place: General cohomological continuity used after constructing the punctured inverse system: sections on quasi-compact opens are represented and identified at a finite stage.

theorem spectralLimit_descend_finite_cover
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (S : I → Type u) [∀ i : I, TopologicalSpace (S i)] [∀ i : I, SpectralSpace (S i)]
    (f : ∀ (i j : I), i ≤ j → S j → S i)
    (hf : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), IsSpectralMap (f i j h))
    (hfid : ∀ (i : I) (x : S i), f i i le_rfl x = x)
    (hfcomp : ∀ (i j k : I) (hij : i ≤ j) (hjk : j ≤ k) (x : S k),
      f i j hij (f j k hjk x) = f i k (hij.trans hjk) x)
    (X : Type v) [TopologicalSpace X] (p : ∀ i : I, X → S i)
    (hp : ∀ i : I, Continuous (p i))
    (hpcomp : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j) (x : X), f i j h (p j x) = p i x)
    (hlimit : ∀ a : ∀ i : I, S i,
      (∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), f i j h (a j) = a i) →
      ∃! x : X, ∀ i : I, p i x = a i)
    (htop : ‹TopologicalSpace X› =
      ⨅ i : I, TopologicalSpace.induced (p i) inferInstance)
    (i : I) (U : Set (S i)) (hUo : IsOpen U) (hUc : IsCompact U)
    (n : ℕ) (V : Fin n → Set (S i)) (W : Fin n → Set X)
    (hV : ∀ a, IsOpen (V a) ∧ IsCompact (V a))
    (hW : ∀ a, IsOpen (W a) ∧ IsCompact (W a))
    (hcover : p i ⁻¹' U = ⋃ a, W a)
    (hincl : ∀ a, W a ⊆ p i ⁻¹' V a) :
    ∃ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j) (D : Fin n → Set (S j)),
      (∀ a, IsOpen (D a) ∧ IsCompact (D a)) ∧
      f i j hij ⁻¹' U = ⋃ a, D a ∧
      (∀ a, p j ⁻¹' D a = W a) ∧
      (∀ a, D a ⊆ f i j hij ⁻¹' V a)
